data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Minos was a king of Crete known for his cruelty and unjust laws. The name 'Minni' is derived from this mythological figure, symbolizing rebellion against unjust rules and standing up for what is right. The name Minni carries the meaning “Rebellious one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Minni usually hope their child will grow to embody rebellious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: 'Minni' as a Christian name can carry a deep spiritual significance, symbolizing the strength and courage to stand up for one's faith and beliefs in the face of adversity. It represents the biblical theme of 'standing firm in the faith' (1 Corinthians 15:58) and 'not being moved by fear' (Philippians 4:14). Moreover, it can be a reminder of the power of prayer and faith, as demonstrated by the story of Minos in Greek mythology who was humbled and transformed by the intervention of the god Apollo. Overall, the name 'Minni' can inspire a deep sense of spiritual resolve and courage in those who bear it.
